channel.title: Institute for Migrant Rights: migration and farmworker law news
channel.description: Significant developments in migration law and farmworker law: new laws, court rulings and ratifications.

item.title: US Labor Department tells court it will set new H-2A wage rates by 30 December
item.description: After a federal court ruled that the 2025 change to the H-2A wage method was unlawful, the Department of Labor told the court it is working to publish replacement wage rates by the court's 30 December 2026 deadline. Source: Capital Press.

item.title: US court rules the H-2A wage cut unlawful
item.description: In a case brought by the United Farm Workers, a federal court in Fresno held that the Labor Department's new method for setting H-2A guest-worker wages, which cut pay by up to $7 an hour, was unlawful. Source: Community Sentinel.

item.title: US Labor Department rescinds 1980 rule on coordinating protections for migrant farmworkers
item.description: The Department of Labor revoked a 1980 regulation on coordinating the enforcement of legal protections for migrant and seasonal farmworkers. Source: Bloomberg Law.

item.title: EU Pact on Migration and Asylum applies from today
item.description: The package of EU regulations on asylum procedures, screening at external borders, Eurodac and solidarity between member states entered into application. Source: European Commission.

item.title: Deadline passes for the recast EU Single Permit Directive
item.description: Member states had to transpose Directive (EU) 2024/1233, which gives third-country workers a single work and residence permit, equal treatment and a right to change employer. Source: MCS (Portugal).

item.title: South Korea suspends seasonal farmworker recruitment from four Thai provinces
item.description: Korea halted recruitment under its seasonal worker scheme from Khon Kaen, Udon Thani, Chaiyaphum and Maha Sarakham. Source: Laotian Times.

item.title: South Korea plans mandatory insurance and safety checks for migrant farmworkers
item.description: The government announced plans for compulsory insurance and safety checklists covering migrant workers on farms. Source: Korea Times.

item.title: Indonesia passes the Domestic Workers Protection Law
item.description: After more than two decades of campaigning, Indonesia's House of Representatives passed a law protecting domestic workers. Source: Asia Pacific Solidarity Network.
